title: Direct destination
description:
Where a directed message is addressed. An ABSENT endpoint means the receiver's configured default_direct_endpoint — it never means fan-out (ADR-0030). If no default exists, or the default has no active lease, the request receives the coarse no_route rejection. The source endpoint is NOT part of this shape: the runtime derives it from the sender's active lease, so a caller cannot spoof another local endpoint.

2.0.0 (ADR-0067 decision 7): every EndpointId here is the derived id of `endpoints/endpoint-id` 2.0.0 -- the 52-character name of the endpoint's Ed25519 key -- and a label of the grammar ADR-0067 retired is refused; no reader of the earlier major tolerates the value, so the shape takes a major.
